fp_contract.selection: Left only when spilled right > spilled left; equality and masked unordered comparison select right spill. Max mirrors the comparison operands and also selects right for equality/masked unordered.
fp_contract.returns: Both paths MOVSS selected spill through XMM0 into [ESP], FLD32 result to ST0, ADD ESP,8, plain RET. Return is selected spill conversion, not necessarily untouched input bits.
fp_contract.environment: Preserve actual x87 load/store, compare and final load timing. FCOMIP is not FUCOMIP. No FP control/status guard, mask changes, C++ value adapter, SSE min/max arithmetic, preload, callback, allocation or external constant. Inputs may alias; literal read/spill order remains.
fp_contract.registers: Eight private stack bytes restored; EAX/ECX/EDX/EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI untouched by body, XMM0 overwritten, final ADD changes flags. Two extra x87 entries may be live; successful return leaves ST0 result.
